name: sortmy-london-mcp
description: Deterministic MCP tools over real London public-service registers (NHS/care, parks & heritage, food hygiene, FCA scam checks) — no LLM call inside a tool, ever (ADR 0007). Unauthenticated, public, rate-limited.

tools.name: sort_my_care
tools.description: Find NHS and public health services near a postcode — GPs, pharmacies, hospitals, dentists.

prompt.description: A UK postcode or London place name (e.g. 'SW9 9SL' or 'Camden') to find nearby NHS/care services.

tools.name: sort_my_wander
tools.description: Find parks, green spaces and listed heritage sites to explore near a postcode.

prompt.description: A UK postcode or London place name to find nearby parks, green spaces, and heritage sites.

tools.name: sort_my_scam_check
tools.description: Check whether a firm is on the FCA's register of authorised financial businesses.

prompt.description: A firm name, FCA reference number (FRN), or Companies House number to check against the FCA register.

tools.name: sort_my_food_hygiene
tools.description: Look up official food hygiene ratings for restaurants and takeaways near a postcode.

prompt.description: A UK postcode or London place name to find nearby food hygiene ratings.
